PZ0-9r0oGNU.t: The Returning Journey from Skopje to Veles
PZ0-9r0oGNU.d1: Hello and welcome back! Here's the returning journey from Skopje to Veles. It was an interesting but cozy ride at dusk, in a good ol' classic passenger loco-hauled train, with electric locomotive 441-044 in front, the one I planned to take on the way to Skopje the same morning. I was also able to film the diesel locomotive 661-410 passing through Skopje train station, 411-101/102 as a passenger train to Kumanovo and 711-003/004 arriving from Bitola. On the way, I met 411-103/104 as a City Train from Zelenikovo to Skopje. Enjoy watching, see you in the next video!

ihm8GcasUZM.t: Taking a Passenger Train from Veles to Skopje
ihm8GcasUZM.d1: Hello and welcome back! Here is a video of a pretty interesting but problematic journey between my hometown Veles and the capital Skopje. Even though the train was late, I enjoyed every part of it. The scenery was great, there were some passing with other trains, such as DMU Macosa 712-103/104 as iR 611 from Skopje to Gevgelija and EMU CRRC 411-103/104 as City Train R3083 from Skopje to Zelenikovo. I was aiming to take the iR 630 from Gevgelija to Skopje because it consisted of an electric locomotive and one compartment coach, but instead ended up on the DMU 711-005/006 as iR 640 from Bitola to Skopje. The good thing is, I got to my destination, even though 1+ hours late. Hope you enjoyed it, and yeah, I filmed the returning journey to Veles, so stay tuned when I post that one too!

dzEP9qfU5Ko.t: [TRIP REPORT] Riding The Only Passenger Train Of Kosovo Trainkos Local Train From Pejë To Pristina
dzEP9qfU5Ko.d1: Trainkos is the railway company in the relatively new country of Kosovo founded in 2011. The country used to have quite an extensive railway network, but the Kosovo War and the following indepence from Serbia didn't do any good to its railway infrastructure. It's been long neglected as it's importance has dwindled greatly. However, railway transport in Kosovo isn't completely dead yet. It's barely surviving with just one remaining railway line in service from Pristina to Pejë.
